message.reasoning:
Assess. C1: good mission concept, users (marine/conservation scientists), rationale, references — Accomplished, 8-9. C2: Gantt chart with task descriptions, but no contingency provision; adequate-to-accomplished. Plan fits mission, references sources. I'd say 7. C3: preliminary progress: STK tutorials 1-4, background research; no actual technical results (no calcs, no orbit numbers). Adequate, 5. C4: presentation: clear structure, good writing, references cited as footnotes matching list mostly; "Useful Links" not cited in text. Adequate-to-accomplished; ~7.

Requirements: R1 yes; R2 partial (plan mentions launch/orbit but no technical detail yet); R3 yes (STK chosen); R4 yes; R5 yes; R6 partial (tutorials only, no results).
